This removes the session from the server and deletes all chats, keys and settings from this device. Make sure you have your recovery key or another verified device, or you will not be able to read your encrypted history again.

Messages, files, reactions and edits in encrypted chats are encrypted on your device with the Matrix protocol (Olm and Megolm, implemented by the Matrix Rust SDK). Only the devices of the people in the chat can decrypt them. This is classical cryptography; it is not post-quantum.
Servers store only encrypted content but see metadata: who is in which chat, when messages are sent, their sizes, chat names and topics, profile names, devices and IP addresses.
A server can add a device to an account it hosts. Verifying your devices and your contacts with emoji comparison lets you detect that; unverified devices and changed identities are shown as warnings.
Your session and the key of the local message database are encrypted with a key held in Android Keystore. Nothing is included in cloud backups or device transfers. Signing out deletes it all.

Calls show \"end-to-end encrypted\" only when the call component reports that every participant\'s media is encrypted with keys exchanged over Matrix. The call server still sees who is connected, when, and audio levels.

When push is enabled, Google and your server\'s push gateway see only that an event arrived (room and event identifiers, unread count), never its content. The message is fetched and decrypted on this device. Previews are hidden by default.
The app lock protects against someone picking up your unlocked phone. It does not protect against a compromised or rooted operating system, or malware with access to the screen.
If you lose your recovery key and all your devices, encrypted history cannot be recovered by anyone. Anyone who can unlock this device can read the chats on it.

Lumen uses the Matrix Rust SDK (Apache-2.0), AndroidX and Jetpack Compose (Apache-2.0), Kotlin and kotlinx (Apache-2.0), JNA (Apache-2.0), Firebase Cloud Messaging (Apache-2.0), Inter and JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL 1.1) and Lucide icons (ISC). Bundled licence texts:
